zh.title: 英國航空下週於14小時長程航線重啟空中巴士A380執飛
zh.summary: 英國航空下週重啟14小時A380航線；該長程航線相隔16個月再度復飛
body: 英國航空預計於下週重新在一條航程約14小時的長程航線上投入空中巴士A380客機營運。根據報導，該條長程航線上次由空中巴士A380執飛已是在16個月前。
此外，其他航空公司亦調整了空中巴士A380的營運規劃。澳洲航空計畫於10月24日執行墨爾本飛往洛杉磯的最後一班空中巴士A380航班，並改由波音787-9接替。阿聯酋航空則在2026年夏季暫時停飛至布拉格（PRG）與格拉斯哥（GLA）的空中巴士A380服務，預計於10月恢復每日班次。

en.title: British Airways To Resume Airbus A380 Flights On 14-Hour Route Next Week
en.summary: British Airways will deploy an Airbus A380 on a 14-hour route next week after 16 months.
body: British Airways is scheduled to launch an Airbus A380 service on a 14-hour route next week. According to reports, this long-haul route last saw operations with the superjumbo aircraft 16 months ago.

Separately, other airlines have adjusted their Airbus A380 schedules for 2026. Qantas plans to operate its final Airbus A380 flight from Melbourne to Los Angeles on October 24 before switching to the Boeing 787-9. Meanwhile, Emirates temporarily suspended Airbus A380 flights to Prague (PRG (PRG)) and Gla (GLA)sgow  for summer 2026, with daily superjumbo services expected to resume in October.
